title: Differentiation of functional astrocytes from human-induced pluripotent stem cells in chemically defined media
protocol: On day 0, remove culture medium from hiPSCs.
Add 1 mL of neural base medium to the dish to remove debris and cells in suspension.
Remove the neural base medium.
Add 1 mL of Neural induction medium + Rock inhibitor Y27632 (10 μM).
Use a cell scraper to draw successive vertical lines in the 35 mm dish to cut iPSC colonies into squares.
Rotate the dish by 90° and redraw the same pattern to obtain smaller squares.
Rotate the dish once more by 45° and redraw the same pattern to further divide the colonies.
Use the cell scraper to lift the clumps of iPSCs by gently scraping the bottom of the dish.
Gently transfer the entire clump suspension into a well of low-binding 6-well plate and add 1 mL of Neural induction medium + Rock inhibitor Y27632 (10 μM).
Incubate at 37°C for 4–6 hours until the clumps have formed spheroids.
Transfer the entire spheroid suspension to a new 35 mm dish coated with poly-L-ornithine/Laminin (PO/L).
Add 8 μL/mL of Laminin to the medium for spheroid attachment.
Incubate at 37°C.
Remove neural induction medium on day 10.
Add 2 mL of NPC expansion medium on day 10.
Change medium as of Day 10 on day 13.
Select areas with high density of rosettes, cut them in squares with a needle on day 13.
Lift the selected rosette squares individually with a 200 μl micropipette on day 13.
Transfer clumps from the 35 mm dish to a new PO/L-coated 35 mm dish.
Add Rock inhibitor Y27632 (10 μM) to the medium.
Change NPC expansion medium on day 14 and incubate cells at 37°C.
Change medium every other day.
Passage cells after 6-7 days or at 80%-100% confluence if earlier.
Remove the culture medium from the cells.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE express per 35 mm dish or 5 mL for a T75 flask.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Harvest the cells into flacon tubes.
Add twice the volume of DMEM/F-12 to the harvested cells.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 300 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in culture medium.
Count the resuspended cells.
Seed the cells in NPC expansion medium on Matrigel-coated flasks at a density of 50,000 cells/cm².
Incubate the seeded cells at 37°C.
Change the medium every other day.
Split NPCs when they become confluent.
Pause point: Cells can be banked at P9 with 5 million cells per vial.
Change NPC culture medium to Astrocyte induction medium at D0 of astrocyte differentiation.
Change medium every other day for 14 days.
Slit cells with TrypLE as described on Step 13 each time they reach confluence during this step (about every 3–4 days).
Switch medium to Astrocyte medium + CNTF (20 ng/mL) at D14.
Change medium every other day from D14 to D28.
Passage cells when confluence reaches 90%–100%.
Seed cells at 40,000 cells/cm² onto Matrigel-coated flasks.
Incubate seeded cells at 37°C.
Evaluate the number of flasks needed based on expected yield of astrocytes.
Between D14 and D21, expect NPC morphology with some neurons present.
Between D21 and D28, anticipate a mix of NPCs, neurons, and immature astrocytes in culture.
From D28 onwards, observe an increasing presence of mature astrocytes in the culture.
By D35, remaining neurons and NPCs should be scarce.
Change medium once every three to four days from D29 to D42.
Plate cells at 20,000 to 30,000 cells/cm² starting from D29.
As astrocytes mature, plate them at a lower density to allow proliferation and obtain good yield.
Culture cells in Astrocyte medium without CNTF from day D42 onward.
Detach the cells from the plate with TrypLE and harvest them.
Count the cells and centrifuge for 5 min at 300 g.
Resuspend the cells at 5 million/mL in Astrocyte medium supplemented with 10% DMSO.
Distribute 1 mL per cryovial and store at -80°C in a Mr FrostyTM container.
Transfer the cells into liquid nitrogen for long-term storage after 3 days.
Prepare a falcon tube containing 9 mL of astrocyte medium per vial to be thawed.
Incubate one vial of NPCs in a water bath at 37°C for 1 min.
Transfer the content of the vial into the falcon tube with astrocyte medium.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of cell culture medium supplemented with Y27632 (10 μM).
Plate the cells in one matrigel-coated T75 flask.
Change the medium after 24 hours to remove Y27632.
